data.raw_text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Officers are currently responding to a tractor trailer blocking lanes of the Trans-Canada Highway near Whitbourne.

Motorists should expect delays and are asked to drive with extreme caution and obey all directions from police.

Road conditions in the area ­— and across the province — are very poor. Please delay any non-essential travel. If you must travel, please exercise extreme caution and patience and drive according to road and weather conditions.
